test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Vishnu was happy **__to push the boat out for__** his fiancée’s birthday.

options.text: and felt so, that his heart started beating faster on
to spend a lot of money because he was celebrating
to take risks that could cause problems or danger on

solution: The correct answer is** Option (3) i.e. "to spend a lot of money because he was celebrating".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **To push the boat out for**: This means to spend a lot of money on something, usually for a celebration. (उत्सव के लिए बहुत सारा पैसा खर्च करना) • **Example**: They really pushed the boat out for their wedding anniversary. • **To spend a lot of money because he was celebrating:** (क्योंकि वह जश्न मना रहा था इसलिए बहुत सारा पैसा खर्च किया) - To use a large amount of money for celebration. • **Example**: He decided to spend a lot of money on a lavish party to celebrate his promotion. • This fits the context where Vishnu wants to celebrate his fiancée's birthday in a special way. **Therefore, the correct answer is *"to spend a lot of money because he was celebrating".*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **But seemed like pretending on:** (नाटक करने जैसा लग रहा था) - Appears as if faking or pretending. • **And felt so, that his heart started beating faster on:** (और ऐसा महसूस हुआ कि उसका दिल जोर से धड़कने लगा) - Felt an intense emotional or physical reaction. • **To take risks that could cause problems or danger on:** (जोखिम उठाना जिससे समस्याएँ या खतरा हो सकता है) - Engaging in actions that could potentially lead to problems or danger. 148:Ta91, The correct answer is **Option (3) I love the dogs.**
